#include <iostream>
#include <vector>
#include <queue>
#include <cstring>
#include <algorithm>
#include <climits>
#include <sstream>

using namespace std;

class CF1187G {
public:
    CF1187G() {}
    
    class Reader {
    private:
        istream& in;
        string line;
        int pos;
        
    public:
        Reader(istream& input) : in(input), pos(0) {}
        
        string next() {
            while (pos >= line.size()) {
                if (!getline(in, line)) throw runtime_error("EOF");
                pos = 0;
                while (pos < line.size() && isspace(line[pos])) pos++;
            }
            int start = pos;
            while (pos < line.size() && !isspace(line[pos])) pos++;
            return line.substr(start, pos - start);
        }
        
        int nextInt() {
            return stoi(next());
        }
    };
    
    static const int INF = 0x3f3f3f3f;
    vector<vector<int>> adj;
    int V, E;
    vector<int> dist, prevDist, prevEdge;
    vector<int> from, to, xorVal, cost;
    vector<int> capacity;
    
    void init(int n, int m) {
        adj.assign(n, vector<int>());
        dist.assign(n, INF);
        prevDist.assign(n, 0);
        prevEdge.assign(n, 0);
        from.assign(m, 0);
        to.assign(m, 0);
        xorVal.assign(m, 0);
        cost.assign(m, 0);
        capacity.assign(m * 2, 0);
        E = 0;
    }
    
    void addEdge(int u, int v, int cap, int c) {
        int idx = E++;
        from[idx] = u;
        to[idx] = v;
        xorVal[idx] = u ^ v;
        cost[idx] = c;
        capacity[idx * 2] = cap;
        adj[u].push_back(idx * 2);
        adj[v].push_back(idx * 2 + 1);
    }
    
    vector<int> queue;
    int qf, ql, qmax;
    vector<bool> inq;
    
    void push(int x) {
        if (inq[x]) return;
        if (qf + ql == (int)queue.size()) {
            if (ql * 2 <= (int)queue.size()) {
                vector<int> newQueue(queue.begin() + qf, queue.begin() + qf + ql);
                queue = newQueue;
                qf = 0;
            } else {
                vector<int> tmp(queue.size() * 2);
                for (int i = 0; i < ql; i++) {
                    tmp[i] = queue[qf + i];
                }
                queue = tmp;
                qf = 0;
            }
        }
        queue[qf + ql++] = x;
        inq[x] = true;
    }
    
    int pop() {
        int x = queue[qf++];
        ql--;
        inq[x] = false;
        return x;
    }
    
    bool spfa(int s, int t) {
        fill(dist.begin(), dist.end(), INF);
        dist[s] = 0;
        qf = ql = 0;
        push(s);
        
        while (ql > 0) {
            int u = pop();
            int nd = prevDist[u] + 1;
            
            for (int e : adj[u]) {
                if (capacity[e] > 0) {
                    int idx = e >> 1;
                    int c = (e & 1) == 0 ? cost[idx] : -cost[idx];
                    int ndist = dist[u] + c;
                    int v = u ^ xorVal[idx];
                    
                    if (dist[v] > ndist || (dist[v] == ndist && prevDist[v] > nd)) {
                        dist[v] = ndist;
                        prevDist[v] = nd;
                        prevEdge[v] = e;
                        push(v);
                    }
                }
            }
        }
        return dist[t] != INF;
    }
    
    void augment(int s, int t) {
        int minCap = INF;
        for (int cur = t; cur != s; cur ^= xorVal[prevEdge[cur] >> 1]) {
            minCap = min(minCap, capacity[prevEdge[cur]]);
        }
        for (int cur = t; cur != s; cur ^= xorVal[prevEdge[cur] >> 1]) {
            int e = prevEdge[cur];
            capacity[e] -= minCap;
            capacity[e ^ 1] += minCap;
        }
    }
    
    void augmentUnit(int s, int t) {
        for (int cur = t; cur != s; cur ^= xorVal[prevEdge[cur] >> 1]) {
            int e = prevEdge[cur];
            capacity[e]--;
            capacity[e ^ 1]++;
        }
    }
    
    int minCostFlow(int s, int t) {
        while (spfa(s, t)) {
            augmentUnit(s, t);
        }
        int total = 0;
        for (int i = 0; i < E; i++) {
            total += cost[i] * capacity[i * 2 + 1];
        }
        return total;
    }
    
    void start() {
        try {
            Reader scan(cin);
            int n = scan.nextInt();
            int m = scan.nextInt();
            int k = scan.nextInt();
            int c = scan.nextInt();
            int d = scan.nextInt();
            
            vector<int> special(k);
            for (int i = 0; i < k; i++) special[i] = scan.nextInt() - 1;
            
            vector<vector<int>> g(n);
            for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) g[i].resize(0);
            
            for (int i = 0; i < m; i++) {
                int u = scan.nextInt() - 1;
                int v = scan.nextInt() - 1;
                g[u].push_back(v);
                g[v].push_back(u);
            }
            
            int T = k + 1;
            int totalNodes = n * T + 1;
            int totalEdges = k + (m * 2 * k + n) * (T - 1);
            init(totalNodes, totalEdges);
            
            for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
                for (int t = 0; t < T - 1; t++) {
                    int u = i * T + t;
                    for (int neighbor : g[i]) {
                        int v = neighbor * T + t + 1;
                        for (int x = 1; x <= k; x++) {
                            addEdge(u, v, 1, c + (x * 2 - 1) * d);
                        }
                    }
                }
            }
            
            for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
                for (int t = 0; t < T - 1; t++) {
                    int u = i * T + t;
                    int v = u + 1;
                    addEdge(u, v, k, i == 0 ? 0 : c);
                }
            }
            
            for (int i = 0; i < k; i++) {
                addEdge(totalNodes - 1, special[i] * T, 1, 0);
            }
            
            cout << minCostFlow(totalNodes - 1, 0 * T + T - 1) << endl;
        } catch (exception& e) {
            throw runtime_error(e.what());
        }
    }
};

int main() {
    CF1187G solver;
    solver.start();
    return 0;
}
